title: Lines that start with a percent sign inside a bare document are scalar text, also before a following document
notes: A directive is read only where a document can start: at the start of the stream or after a document end marker `...` (l-yaml-stream, production 211). The text `%x` and `%y` follows the plain scalar `a` in a bare document, so they are continuation lines of that scalar (ns-plain-char, production 130, admits `%`, and a continuation line may start with it, production 134), folded to single spaces: the first document is `a %x %y`. `---` then starts the second document, which needs no `...` before it (production 211: an explicit document may follow a bare one).

provenance.reference: A reader that stopped the scalar at a line starting with a percent sign and failed or dropped the lines. The yaml-test-suite case XLQ9 covers a lone lookalike line only.
